# SlickChart

> SlickChart is the all-in-one app for independent estheticians and other solo beauty, health and wellness pros. It is built to help them earn outside the treatment room with virtual consults, a course and guide builder, and shoppable homecare plans, plus client charting, before and after photos, digital consent forms, booking, invoicing, payments and reports, from a phone or computer. Providers pay $17 a month (or $170 a year) after a 14-day free trial. Clients always use it free, with no app to download.

Website: https://slickchart.app
Contact: support@slickchart.app
Apps: iPhone https://apps.apple.com/app/id6792418818 , Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.slickchart.app , and in any web browser.

## Who it is for

Solo providers: estheticians, permanent makeup (PMU) artists, tattoo and body artists, massage therapists, nail techs, lash and brow artists, hair stylists, head spa providers, nutritionists, and health and wellness coaches.

## What it does

- Virtual photo and product consults that end in product picks the client can buy
- Course and guide builder: sell courses and send guides
- Shoppable homecare plans through the provider's own shop, vendor affiliate links or Amazon. SlickChart takes no cut.
- Client charting, notes, face charting, and before and after photo comparison
- Digital intake, consent and liability forms with contraindication flagging, plus ready-made form collections for 8 professions
- Booking that works on its own, with Google and Apple Calendar sync. Square is optional and connects in one click.
- Invoicing, payments, tips, sales tax, inventory, and income reports
- Client messaging and a free client app that opens in the browser
- AI voice notes and visit summaries, each with an off switch

## Pricing

- $17 a month, or $170 a year. Every feature included, no higher tiers.
- 14 days free for new providers.
- Always free for clients.
